channel.description: Latest articles from Best Little Sites (comicbookmovie.com)

item.title: IT'S NOT LIKE THAT Interview: Scott Foley Talks SCREAM 7 Return And Turning Down SCRUBS Revival (Exclusive)
item.description: Talking to us about his phenomenal turn in It's Not Like That, Scott Foley addresses his upcoming Scream 7 return and why he had to turn down the upcoming Scrubs revival.

item.title: DC Studios Three Years Later: Every Announced DCU Movie and TV Show That Still Hasn't Started Production
item.description: It's been nearly three years since DC Studios announced the "Chapter 1: Gods and Monsters" slate, and many of those projects haven't happened. Here's a closer look at the movies and TV shows in limbo.

item.title: James Gunn Shares New SUPERMAN Fortress Of Solitude Photo As Work On MAN OF TOMORROW Ramps Up
item.description: As excitement for next summer's Man of Tomorrow continues to build, DC Studios co-CEO James Gunn has shared a new behind-the-scenes photo from the set of Superman.

item.title: MERCY Interview: Chris Pratt On What Drew Him To An Original Sci-Fi After Playing Star-Lord (Exclusive)
item.description: We talk to Mercy star Chris Pratt and filmmaker Timur Bekmambetov about their new sci-fi movie, learning more about what drew each of them to the project.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Rumor: Steve Rogers And [SPOILER] Will Fight - But Are They Going To Be A Variant?
item.description: According to a new Avengers: Doomsday rumour, Chris Evans's Steve Rogers/Captain America will square off with a surprising ally in the movie. One of them has to be a Variant, right?

item.title: MAN OF TOMORROW Is Reportedly Looking To Cast Maxima As The Sequel's Secondary Antagonist
item.description: After James Gunn debunked the Wonder Woman rumours, a new report claims that he's looking to cast the villainous Maxima for his upcoming Superman sequel, Man of Tomorrow.

item.title: TOMB RAIDER: GameStop Rejects Sophie Turner's Take On Lara Croft
item.description: Video game retailer GameStop has sparked controversy by reacting negatively to Sophie Turner’s Lara Croft reveal in Prime Video’s upcoming Tomb Raider series.

item.title: "LOL": Rian Johnson Responds To Kathleen Kennedy's Comments About His Unmade STAR WARS Trilogy
item.description: Star Wars: The Last Jedi director Rian Johnson has broken his silence on recent claims from former Lucasfilm President Kathleen Kennedy about why he didn't move forward with his trilogy.

item.title: GUARDIANS OF THE GALAXY Star Chris Pratt Has A Surprising Take On What Star-Lord's Been Up To On Earth
item.description: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3 brought Star-Lord back to Earth, and actor Chris Pratt has now shared his surprising take on what he believes Peter Quill has been up to ever since.
